title: Stack-based Traversal
intuition: Emulate recursive backtracking traversals using an explicit stack structure, avoiding recursion limits.
step_by_step_strategy: Initialize stack with starting state (e.g. root node).
While stack is not empty, pop element.
Push right and left children in correct order.
common_mistakes: Incorrect child push ordering (left vs right)
Failing to check null children before push
content: Emulate recursive backtracking traversals using an explicit stack structure, avoiding recursion limits.
